steps.label: score-unpinned

steps.label: bucket-pg-query
steps.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '2026-10-31 00:59:59.9Z'::timestamptz - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz)::bigint / 3600 AS near_hour, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '2026-10-31 01:00:00Z'::timestamptz - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz)::bigint / 3600 AS on_hour

steps.label: bucket-pg-boundaries
steps.sql: SELECT t, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz)::bigint / 3600 AS documented_hour, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz) / 3600)::bigint AS floored_hour FROM (SELECT '1969-12-31 23:59:59Z'::timestamptz AS t UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 00:00:00Z'::timestamptz UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 00:59:59.4Z'::timestamptz UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 00:59:59.9Z'::timestamptz UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 01:00:00Z'::timestamptz) q ORDER BY t

steps.label: pg-jsonb-sort
steps.sql: SELECT x FROM (SELECT '2'::jsonb x UNION ALL SELECT '1'::jsonb UNION ALL SELECT 'null'::jsonb) q ORDER BY x

steps.label: pg-jsonb-count
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(x) AS n FROM (SELECT '1'::jsonb x) q

steps.label: json-table
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE JsonDocs (Id bigint PRIMARY KEY, Doc jsonb, Tokens spanner.tokenlist GENERATED ALWAYS AS (spanner.tokenize_jsonb(Doc)) VIRTUAL HIDDEN)

steps.label: json-index
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX JsonSearch ON JsonDocs(Tokens)

steps.label: json-search-equal-auto
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs WHERE Doc->'kind'='"active"'::jsonb ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-equal-search
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs/*@ FORCE_INDEX=JsonSearch */ WHERE Doc->'kind'='"active"'::jsonb ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-equal-base
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs/*@ FORCE_INDEX=_BASE_TABLE */ WHERE Doc->'kind'='"active"'::jsonb ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-in-auto
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs WHERE Doc->'kind' IN ('"active"'::jsonb,'"pending"'::jsonb) ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-in-search
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs/*@ FORCE_INDEX=JsonSearch */ WHERE Doc->'kind' IN ('"active"'::jsonb,'"pending"'::jsonb) ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-in-base
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs/*@ FORCE_INDEX=_BASE_TABLE */ WHERE Doc->'kind' IN ('"active"'::jsonb,'"pending"'::jsonb) ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-whole-auto
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs WHERE Doc='{"n":1,"kind":"active"}'::jsonb ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-whole-search
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs/*@ FORCE_INDEX=JsonSearch */ WHERE Doc='{"n":1,"kind":"active"}'::jsonb ORDER BY Id

steps.label: json-search-whole-base
steps.sql: SELECT Id FROM JsonDocs/*@ FORCE_INDEX=_BASE_TABLE */ WHERE Doc='{"n":1,"kind":"active"}'::jsonb ORDER BY Id
